technology_name: Probiotic from Infant Microbiome for Infection Prevention: Prophylactic/Adjuvant Formulation
institution: KSCSTE- Centre of Excellence in Microbiome (CoEM)
problem_solved: The escalating global threat of multi-drug resistant bacterial infections and antibiotic resistance, particularly against last-resort antibiotics like colistin.
description: A novel probiotic formulation derived from the infant gut microbiome developed as a prophylactic and adjuvant solution against multi-drug resistant pathogens. The lead strain exhibits potent broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity, notably against colistin-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae, MRSA, drug-resistant Vibrio cholerae, Salmonella enterica, Shigella sonnei, and enteropathogenic E. coli. Comprehensive genome sequencing validates human safety by confirming the absolute absence of virulence factors and transferable antibiotic resistance genes.
applications:
• Development of targeted therapeutic biotics and antibiotic adjuvants

• Formulation of premium functional foods and dietary health supplements

• Clinical pipelines for managing multi-drug resistant hospital infections

• Commercial out-licensing to healthcare enterprises and biotechnology firms
